create_stable_diffusion_pipeline: create a StableDiffusionPipeline from a pretrained model checkpoint path
configure_dpm_solver_scheduler: configure DPMSolverMultistepScheduler as the inference scheduler for StableDiffusionPipeline
optimize_models_with_ipex: optimize unet, vae, and text_encoder modules with intel_extension_for_pytorch in bfloat16
generate_image_with_autocast: generate an image from a text prompt using torch.cpu.amp.autocast with bfloat16 dtype
run_inference_with_custom_steps: run StableDiffusionPipeline inference with a custom number of inference steps via argparse
